hinge.title: Decide how the pressure from a solid contact changes when the perpendicular force or the area of contact changes.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: 10 N on 1 m² produces greater pressure than 100 N on 2 m².

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: At the same force, doubling the contact area doubles the pressure.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The upright pyramid exerts greater pressure than the block.

intelligence.enrichment: For a force acting perpendicular to a surface, pressure is force per unit area; for the same force, a smaller area gives higher pressure and a larger area gives lower pressure. Increasing perpendicular force raises pressure, while increasing the area over which that force is spread lowers pressure. The learner calculates pressure as perpendicular force divided by contact area and predicts that the same force gives higher pressure on a smaller area. A heavier-feeling bag strap always means the bag has more weight, so the strap width is not part of the pressure explanation.
